title: Exact physical source sharing is present in 30 static records
disposition: Preserve all values. No uniqueness invariant for mappings inferred. Consumer and hardware behavior unverified.

title: Directional field variations must not be normalized away
disposition: All variations read and preserved. Rotated hats, axes as direction sources and one unprovided dpup do not prove consumer failure.

title: High numeric indices and leading-zero button spellings lack device bounds or parser proof
disposition: Indices read as data tokens. Numeric inspection thresholds are audit heuristics, not admissible-control bounds.

title: Identifier exceptions, star display names and trailing name whitespace require separate consumer interpretation
disposition: No trimming, wildcard expansion, opaque-GUID decoding or xinput validity claim.

title: Sparse records describe schema omissions, not absent framework/hardware features
disposition: Each sparse row has its missing keys and signed components recorded. No defaults or completeness requirement imposed.

title: Exact source order matters to traceability even where key-value sets repeat
disposition: Preserve 790 ordered patterns. Two pairs share key-value sets in differing order. Consumer ordering rule not established.

title: Embedded multi-platform SDL data does not prove selected runtime consumer, host support or game-action behavior
disposition: Static full semantic scope complete. Runtime and formal coverage remain unverified/unassessed in this child.
